- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast periods, especially after recent spikes; reduce forecast by 2–5% for 1–3 day horizons.
- After sentiment turns negative (e.g., -0.25 or 0.50), model tends to ignore downward momentum; apply downward bias of 3–8% for 5–10 day horizons.
- Forecast shows gradual upward drift after peak, but true price often reverses sharply; cap forecast slope at 0.5% per day after 10-day high.
- Mean reversion is strong in 15–30 day horizons; if forecast > 72.5, reduce by 1–3% per day until price stabilizes.
- If sentiment is neutral or positive, model may overfit recent trends; use 3–5 day moving average to smooth forecast for 30-day horizon.
